faq.question: How long does referral tracking last?
faq.answer: Our cookie window is 60 days. If someone clicks your link and installs within 60 days, you earn recurring commission on their subscription.

faq.question: When and how are commissions paid?
faq.answer: Commissions are paid monthly on a Net-15 schedule via PayPal, Stripe Transfer, or Direct Wire Transfer once your balance reaches $50.

faq.question: Do you offer free app licenses for my agency development stores?
faq.answer: Yes! All verified Shopify Partners and Agencies qualify for free staging and development store licenses for all Yuvora apps.

faq.question: Can I refer merchants directly as an agency without affiliate links?
faq.answer: Yes, we also offer Partner Co-Selling credit where you can register merchant domains directly via your agency account manager.

payoutFrequency: Monthly Net-15 via PayPal or Wire
